message.content:
**Traffic Laws in Texas – A Quick Reference Guide** | Topic | Key Points | Where to Find More Info | |-------|------------|------------------------| | **Speed Limits** | • Posted limits apply unless otherwise indicated.
• 55 mph on rural interstates, 65 mph on urban interstates, 45 mph on freeways, 35 mph on expressways, 25 mph on city streets.
• School zones: 25 mph (or 20 mph if posted). | Texas Department of Transportation (TxDOT) – Speed Limits page | | **Seat‑belt & Child Safety** | • All drivers and passengers must wear seat belts.
• Children under 8 must be in a child safety seat or booster.
• No “seat‑belt law” for teens 16‑17, but they must wear a seat belt if the driver does. | Texas Transportation Code §545.001 | | **Cell‑Phone Use** | • Hand‑held phone use while driving is prohibited (unless using a hands‑free system).
• Texting while driving is illegal. | TxDOT – Mobile Phone Use | | **Driving Under Influence (DUI)** | • Blood Alcohol Concentration (BAC) of 0.08% or higher is illegal.
• Zero‑tolerance for drivers under 21 (0.02% BAC).
• Penalties: fines, license suspension, possible jail time. | Texas Alcoholic Beverage Commission (TABC) – DUI | | **Right‑of‑Way** | • Yield to pedestrians at crosswalks.
• Stop at stop signs and red lights.
• “Right‑of‑way” rules for intersections, merging, and roundabouts. | Texas Transportation Code §545.001 | | **Lane‑Changing & Overtaking** | • Must signal and check mirrors/blind spots.
• “No passing” zones on two‑lane roads. | TxDOT – Lane‑Changing | | **School Bus Rules** | • Stop for a school bus with its red lights flashing and stop sign extended.
• Cannot pass a stopped school bus. | Texas Transportation Code §545.001 | | **Parking Regulations** | • No parking within 20 ft of a crosswalk, fire hydrant, or intersection.
• No parking in handicap spaces unless you have a valid permit. | TxDOT – Parking | | **Vehicle Registration & Inspection** | • Vehicles must be registered and display a valid license plate.
• Most vehicles require an annual safety inspection (except some exempt categories). | Texas Department of Motor Vehicles (TxDMV) | | **Insurance Requirements** | • Minimum liability coverage: $30,000 for bodily injury per person, $60,000 for total bodily injury, $25,000 for property damage. | TxDMV – Insurance | | **Traffic Citations & Penalties** | • Points system: 4 points for a first offense, 6 for a second, 8 for a third.
• License suspension after 12 points in 12 months. | TxDMV – Points System | | **Special Situations** | • “No‑stop” or “no‑turn” signs.
• “One‑way” streets.
• “No‑passing” zones. | TxDOT – Traffic Signs | ### How to Stay Updated - **TxDOT Website** – Official rules, updates, and driver’s handbook. - **TxDMV** – Licensing, registration, insurance, and penalties. - **Texas Transportation Code** – The legal text; available online via the Texas Legislature website. ### Quick Tips 1. **Always obey posted signs** – they override general rules. 2. **Use hands‑free devices** if you need to talk or text. 3. **Check your vehicle’s inspection status** before driving. 4. **Keep your insurance documents in the car** – you may need to show them. Feel free to ask if you need details on a specific law or how to handle a particular situation!
